about: Readability floors for a drawn stage at rest (backdrop and platforms, no actors, no interface). A zone passes when at least `floor` of its pixels give the stage's ink `contrast`:1 or better. Rectangles are x, y, width, height in the 1600x900 world frame. A stage that moves is measured at time 0 and at each of `motion.times` (seconds of its own motion): the floors must hold at every one, and in `motion.zone` the share of pixels that differ from time 0 by `motion.step` or more on a 0-255 colour channel, and the mean difference, must stay under the two ceilings. With reduced motion on, every moment must equal time 0. Read by tests/stage-readability.js; tests/unit/stage-art.test.ts requires every drawn stage to be listed in `stages`. Floors are only ever raised and motion ceilings only ever lowered.
